name: Carpet Colors That Won't Date Your House
title-tag: Carpet Color Trends: Colors That Won't Date Your House
meta-description: The carpet colors that survive every trend cycle: warm mid-tone neutrals with fleck. What shows dirt, the resale logic, and checking undertones at home.
post-summary: February 11, 2027 · The carpet colors that do not date a house are warm mid-tone neutrals with visible fleck — oatmeal, greige, mushroom, taupe. Why strong trend colors become timestamps, which color families hide dirt and which display it, the resale logic, and why undertones must be checked in your own light before you buy.
